name: Range upper-channel breakout momentum — buy the break of the range high
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the OPPOSITE-SIDE read of range_position vs range-floor-accumulation, which buys the range FLOOR for reversion; this buys the break of the range CEILING for continuation): range_position is the Donchian/stochastic channel position in [0,1] — near 0 = range floor, near 1 = range ceiling. range-floor-accumulation harvests grid-bot mean-reversion off the floor; this spec harvests the BREAKOUT: when price pushes through the TOP of its recent range (range_position crossing up toward 1) it signals the range has resolved UPWARD — accumulated demand has absorbed the overhead supply and a new trend leg begins (the classic Donchian channel breakout / turtle entry). Confirm with a rising ADX so we trade a real trend resolution, not a single-bar poke above a chop range that fails. Entry: range_position crosses UP through a fitted ceiling (range high breaking) AND adx above a fitted trend-strength floor (trend igniting). Exit: range_position crosses DOWN back into the range (failed breakout / back inside) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if an unconditional momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the channel breakout adds no timing edge. Disconfirmer 2: this is the directional inverse of range-floor-accumulation on the SAME feature — the two must NOT be double-counted (range floor reversion vs range ceiling breakout are distinct regimes). Disconfirmer 3: breakouts are notoriously fakeout-prone — if removing the ADX confirmation leaves the edge unchanged, the breakout itself is noise. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): the continuation must clear ~20bps round-trip net. Price/TA-only — always-on, no feed dependency.
catalyst: price breaking the top of its recent range with a rising ADX — a Donchian channel breakout
